z8xv3m72.baseName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
z8xv3m72.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
z8xv3m72.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 8ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine. This beautifully full artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 550 multi-function warm white LED lights, creating an impressive centrepiece for your Christmas celebrations. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. There is plenty of foliage to showcase your favourite decorations. We love its gently upswept branches and classic, tapered shape, with natural shades of green and subtle brown detailing adding character throughout. At 8ft tall, it makes a striking feature in rooms with higher ceilings. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 8ft • Pre-lit: 550 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 2,036 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 130cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and three tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 65cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Carton dimensions: 128cm × 40cm × 42cm • Weight: 23.65kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
